scope: Single-agent source/teaching audit. The numerical constructions are explanatory examples, not paper measurements or a user comprehension study.

claims.claim: Reference motion specifies the desired body motion; the deterministic actor outputs a normalized joint setpoint based on observation and goal.
claims.evidence: Supplied PDF p4, Section3.1; p8, control period; p17, deployment.
claims.clarity_change: Separate reference motion, executed action, simulator logs and deployment control.

claims.claim: A differentiable surrogate supplies action/state derivatives for policy training even when simulator rigid-body dynamics are already specified. Actor and critic updates are two substeps of the third training phase.
claims.evidence: Supplied PDF p5, Section3.2; p15, AlgorithmA.1.
claims.clarity_change: Add motivation before world-model equations and explicitly reconcile the three-phase loop with the four-row parameter table.

claims.claim: The model fits logged action windows; actor improvement uses new actions from the current policy, with model/critic weights fixed during the actor step.
claims.evidence: PDF pp4–5, Figure2 and Equations1–3; p15, AlgorithmA.1.
claims.clarity_change: Put phase/parameter table before the equations, then repeat the data-source distinction.

claims.claim: Default k8, H32 and 50Hz imply trajectory durations0.16s and0.64s, separate from execution wall time.
claims.clarity_change: Separate control cycle, model-fit window and actor imagination.

claims.claim: Frozen network parameters can still transmit derivatives with respect to their inputs; eval mode does not freeze weights.
claims.evidence: PDF p5, BPTT through the frozen model; PyTorch2.14 autograd notes; published scalar snippet executed with PyTorch2.8.0+cpu.
claims.clarity_change: Add an optional executed freeze example and retain standard-library finite differences.

claims.claim: The terminal value participates in the actor objective through its state input; lambda mixes critic targets while actor still uses the window-return/terminal-value objective.
claims.evidence: PDF p5, Equations2–3; p15, critic target fitting; p16, gamma0.99/lambda0.95.
claims.clarity_change: Add the0.55/0.58 comparison and explain lambda0/1 endpoints.

claims.claim: Analytic versus learned reward/observation/termination heads is left implementation-dependent by the method description.
claims.clarity_change: Retain the distinction and avoid inventing separate trained networks for every head.

claims.claim: Classic InstructGPT uses demonstrations, human comparisons, a learned reward model and PPO; fitting the reward model is a separate update from policy optimization.
claims.evidence: InstructGPT v1, pp3,6–7; independent Bradley–Terry arithmetic from the current table.
claims.clarity_change: Track phi versus theta and distinguish score model, critic, reference and sampling policy.

claims.claim: DPO directly optimizes the policy from preference pairs and need not fit an explicit reward model or perform online PPO.
claims.clarity_change: Separate preference-data provenance from downstream update choice in prose and the existing SVG.

claims.claim: GRPO uses a group baseline in place of a learned value model; verifiable scoring need not be differentiable.
claims.evidence: DeepSeek-R1 v1, pp5–6; policy-score gradient explanation and exact population-standard-deviation construction.
claims.clarity_change: Connect(1,1,0,0) to(1,1,-1,-1), preserve the epsilon qualification and explain why zero-sum advantages do not force a zero gradient.

claims.claim: RLCD labels positive-branch outputs as preferred without post-hoc AI scoring, trains a preference model, then runs PPO.
claims.clarity_change: List the original four stages; identify DPO with similarly synthesized pairs as an alternative downstream choice.

claims.claim: RLCD contrasts attribute-conditioned output distributions; prompt surface forms should stay similar.
claims.clarity_change: Explain context distillation and the possible length/style shortcut.

claims.claim: RLCD30B indicates a30B preference-data generator; the final model being aligned remains LLaMA7B.
claims.evidence: RLCD v3, p6, Section4 implementation paragraph.
claims.clarity_change: Separate the general same-model setup from the two reported generation configurations.

claims.claim: Synthetic training labels and independent human evaluation are distinct; the paper also reports separate human comparison evaluation.
claims.clarity_change: Correct the reversed audit answer and clarify that evaluation does not require manually relabeling every training pair.
